digest.component_or_area: live Jira Cloud S3 reconciliation test suite
propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live test suite for multi-project Jira Cloud reconciliation was removed during a pivot to Data Center and must be restored to exercise S3 store backend and real Cloud ticket volume across projects REB and DIG

The suite must enforce structural read-only invariants by monkeypatching all 18 mutating AcliClient methods to raise, ensuring compute_snapshot and bridge_preview in DRY_RUN mode cannot write to Jira or the store
Per-project issue counts on Jira must remain identical before and after each test scenario, with zero mutations reported by the outbound reconciler
An unknown mapped project key must fail closed (raise) during snapshot computation rather than silently succeeding
The S3 store backend roundtrips correctly with git-remote-s3, preserving the REB+DIG project mapping through push and clone
The test suite is gated by REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL, AWS credentials, and Jira credentials, with a dedicated jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal CI job and throwaway S3 prefix cleanup on teardown
